rationale: Class 3 anchor check: the filing balance sheet and the schedule of investments agree that June 30, 2024 investments at fair value are 181.356 million. The queued rule artifact reports a BDC GAV reconciliation ratio of 0.6243, implying extracted covered fair value of about 113.214 million, far below the raw-source investment total. Because the source anchor is internally consistent and the extracted coverage is materially incomplete, the flag is a real extraction coverage error rather than a false alarm. The raw source does not isolate a single residual-tie row, so localization remains aggregate.
